verdict.rationale: Helix Cloud docs describe only row-level isolation implemented at the application layer, explicitly noting 'no structural constraints on the database' rather than native namespaces, partitions, or per-tenant collections; RBAC/scoped API keys and rate-limit overrides exist but are not tied to a documented per-tenant isolation model with limits. missing for 10: native namespace/partition/collection-based tenant isolation, documented per-tenant resource limits, and any benchmark or case study showing cheap multi-tenant scaling.
